children.value: > Fact From Story: Google nevertheless promised improvements in reasoning, planning and understanding with Gemini Pro over the previous model powering Bard, claiming Gemini Pro was better at summarizing content, brainstorming and writing.
> > Fact From Story: But the anecdotal evidence suggests otherwise.
> > Fact From Story: Clearly, it has some work to do in those departments.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If a company emphasizes the capabilities of a product, but anecdotal evidence suggests otherwise, then the product may not be as good as the company claims.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If a product has "some work to do" in certain areas, it means that it is not as good in those areas as it could be.
